reviewer.name: Codex independent initial full-chapter date auditor

summary: Complete independent audit of all 57 Jiuwudaishi 011 Chinese source units, 93 temporal and active-date-hint records, and 34 people. The direct regnal-year conversions for dated investitures, the 915 death of Virtue Consort Zhang, and the 910 veil order are retained. Revision is required because later honors, reburial, named-consort and bibliographical references have been converted into living attestations or active hints, while multiple source-undated assertions have been inflated into reign- or dynasty-wide activity windows. The source also does not state the stored AD 907 point for Wang’s enfeoffment from Zhu Wen’s earlier Bian command.
